jobs.occupation: Technical Writer to a global company in Ludvika
jobs.description:
About our client
Our client, who is a global and world leading actor within their domain, strongly believe in the long-term sustainability of HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology. This technology facilitates energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, making it suitable for transmitting energy over long distances and connecting electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology addresses electricity quality issues and contributes to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the most realistic energy transmission alternative.
About the role
On behalf of our client, we are looking for an experienced Technical Writer to join their team in Ludvika.
In this role, you will be responsible for creating, structuring, and maintaining technical documentation for complex electrical systems and installations, covering everything from high- and low-voltage systems to control systems, HMI, and related equipment.
You will work closely with system engineers, technical specialists, and project teams to gather, analyze, and transform complex technical information into clear, accurate, and well-structured documentation. The role requires both technical understanding and strong communication skills, as you will play an important part in ensuring that technical information is accessible, consistent, and easy to understand across different engineering projects.
Key responsibilities
Create, structure, and maintain technical documentation for electrical installations, systems, and engineering solutions

Gather and interpret technical information in close collaboration with engineers and technical specialists

Produce user manuals, system descriptions, technical specifications, and other relevant documentation

Review, improve, and standardize existing technical documentation to ensure quality, accuracy, and consistency

Plan and coordinate documentation activities across multiple engineering projects

Contribute to improving documentation processes, templates, and ways of working

Who are you?
We are looking for a structured and communicative person who enjoys combining technical understanding with clear and precise writing. You have a genuine interest in technology and the ability to understand complex technical systems and explain them in a way that is easy for others to understand.
To succeed in this role, you are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, manage your own priorities, and enjoy collaborating with engineers and technical specialists across different projects. You also take pride in delivering high-quality documentation and contributing to the development of effective ways of working.
We are looking for someone who has:
At least 5 years of experience in technical writing or technical documentation

A university degree, Bachelor’s or higher, in a relevant technical field

Experience documenting complex technical systems or engineering solutions

Good written and verbal communication skills in English

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience with electrical systems, power systems, HVDC technology, or industrial installations

Good communication skills in Swedish

Practical information
Location: Ludvika, Sweden
Scope: Full-time
Start date: As agreed
Employment type: In this recruitment process, you will initially be employed as a consultant by A-hub and work on assignment at our client. After 12 months, the ambition is for you to transition into direct employment with the client.

We look forward to receiving your application!
A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy.

The Opportunity
At Hitachi Energy Components in Ludvika, we are continuing to grow and develop our business. As more employees join our organization and new competencies are required, ensuring a structured and effective approach to onboarding, training, and competency development has become increasingly important.
We are now looking for a Training & Development Specialist who will take ownership of our internal training structure and learning processes. This is a newly established role with significant opportunity to influence how onboarding, training, and competency development are managed across our organization.
We are looking for someone who enjoys creating structure, coordinating initiatives, and working with a broad range of stakeholders. You bring experience from an industrial, manufacturing, energy, or other technical environment and are comfortable collaborating with technical experts and operational teams.

How you’ll make an impact
Coordinate onboarding and support the continuous improvement of the new employee experience.
Develop and maintain internal training processes and competency development structures.
Coordinate training programs and collaborate with stakeholders across Sweden and globally to ensure relevant and up-to-date training content.
Create and maintain training materials, presentations, guides, and learning resources.
Support subject matter experts in developing structured and effective training programs.
Manage learning systems, training documentation, records, and competency data.
Track training KPIs, identify improvement opportunities, and support continuous development of learning initiatives.

Your Background
Experience in a coordination-focused role such as project coordination, HR, administration, executive support, competency management, or similar.
Experience from an industrial, manufacturing, energy, or engineering environment, with the ability to understand technical roles, processes, and competency requirements.
Experience supporting, delivering, or coordinating training and development initiatives is highly regarded.
Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the confidence to engage and present across different functions and organizational levels.
A continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify development opportunities and drive improvements.
Professional communication skills in both Swedish and English.

Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

About the role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join an exciting technology-driven assignment focused on building scalable data solutions and backend services.
Duration: 1 Year Contract.
Are you passionate about data engineering, distributed processing, and solving complex technical challenges? This role offers the opportunity to build and maintain data pipelines, develop backend APIs, and contribute to solutions used across a collaborative engineering environment.
We’re looking for someone who combines strong programming skills with a proactive mindset, takes ownership of deliverables, and enjoys sharing knowledge with fellow engineers.
📍 Location: Malmö, Sweden
🏢 Work model: Hybrid – on-site at the client’s office 3 days per week
🎯 About the Role
As a Data Engineer, you will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data-processing solutions. You will work with modern data technologies and backend frameworks to ensure reliable access to data and efficient data workflows.
You will collaborate closely with other engineers, provide technical guidance where needed, and help drive continuous improvements across the team's data engineering capabilities.
🔧 Key Responsibilities
Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines using distributed data-processing technologies.
Develop and maintain scalable data solutions that support the team's needs.
Build backend APIs and services to enable efficient and reliable access to data.
Provide technical support and share knowledge with colleagues on data engineering topics.
Identify opportunities for technical improvements and drive initiatives from idea to implementation.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to design practical, scalable solutions.
Take end-to-end ownership of your work and ensure high-quality delivery.
Contribute to a collaborative, high-trust, and fast-paced engineering environment.
Skills
Python
Scala
Java

Skills & requirements
✅ Required Skills & Qualifications
Professional experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role.
Strong programming skills in Python and Java or Scala.
Solid backend development experience, ideally with Scala Play Framework or an equivalent framework.
Strong general software engineering and problem-solving skills.
Experience developing and maintaining software solutions and data-processing workflows.
A bachelor's degree in a relevant field; a master's degree is a strong advantage.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to work independently, take responsibility, and drive tasks forward.
A collaborative mindset with a willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues.

⭐ Nice-to-Have Skills & Technologies
Experience with one or more of the following technologies will be an advantage:

👤 Our Ideal Candidate
You thrive in an environment where you are trusted to take ownership and make independent decisions. You are analytical, creative, and comfortable tackling challenges with limited guidance.
At the same time, you value teamwork, communicate your ideas clearly, and enjoy helping others succeed. You balance technical innovation with practical delivery and continuously look for ways to improve existing systems and workflows.
📩 Interested in This Opportunity?
If you have strong Python and Java/Scala skills, backend development experience, and an interest in scalable data engineering, we’d like to hear from you.
Send us your updated CV highlighting your data engineering projects, programming expertise, backend experience, and relevant technologies.

About Plus1 
Plus1 is a fast-growing fintech on a mission to give people total control over their personal finances. We don’t just offer loans, we build digital solutions and provide expert advisory services that make a real difference across Europe. Plus1 is part of 0TO9 AB, a licensed credit market company supervised by the Swedish FSA (Finansinspektionen).
We are scaling quickly and building out our organization. This is your chance to join a team where your voice carries weight, where you help set the direction, and where you can help build the next fintech success story.
Learn more about Plus1
The Role
We are looking for a Product Manager who doesn’t just set direction, but builds. You will join our product and tech team of 11 in Stockholm, report directly to the CEO and work closely with the management team.
We don’t split the product into silos with individual owners. We work full stack, all hands on deck, across the entire customer and business chain. Priorities are set together with management, with special focus on:

Traffic generation

Onboarding and conversion

Retention and dunning

The credit granting process

Market expansion

Internal systems used by our advisors and customer service agents

We build a lot ourselves with Claude Code. As a PM you won’t just write requirements and manage the backlog. You will pair with our developers, build prototypes, internal tools and analyses yourself, and improve how we work every day.
Your mission includes:

Driving priorities and roadmap across our focus areas, based on data, customer insight and business impact.

Building and shipping hands-on together with the developers, from prototype to production.

Monitoring performance across the funnel, from first click to repayment, and acting quickly when something needs adjusting.

Making sure everything we build meets regulatory requirements, including consumer credit regulation, CCD2, AML/KYC and GDPR, in close collaboration with legal, compliance and credit.

Managing external partners such as payment providers, brokers and credit bureaus.

Aligning internal stakeholders across credit, customer service, finance, marketing and management.

Contributing to launches in new markets, from requirements and partner setup to go-live.

Who You Are
We are looking for a “Founder’s Mentality.” You are analytical, results-driven and thrive in an environment where things move fast. You don’t wait for a to-do list, you see what needs to be done and you drive it to completion, often by building it yourself.

3-5 years of experience in consumer credit, financial services or another regulated business, ideally as a product manager, product owner or in business development.

Hands-on with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, and comfortable working in a codebase alongside developers.

A solid understanding of credit processes, risk management and consumer credit regulation.

Experience managing both internal and external stakeholders.

The drive to work independently, while loving being part of a team where everyone supports each other.

Fluent in English, spoken and written.

Why join Plus1?
Report directly to the CEO, with short decision paths and real influence.

Work in a team that actually builds with AI every day, not just talks about it.

Work across the full customer journey and help people improve their financial health every day.

Be part of our expansion into new European markets.

Work in a high-ceiling, innovative environment in the heart of Stockholm, where you and your ideas actually matter.

TAKTEAM
SEASONAL 6-MONTH EMPLOYMENT 2027
ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN
Would you like to become part of a growing company that offers good opportunities for professional development while contributing to the sustainable maintenance and protection of our customers’ homes?
Then send your application today!
Candidate selection takes place on an ongoing basis.
JOB DESCRIPTION
As a member of our team, you will represent the company to our customers while carrying out the work. Most of the work takes place in different areas of Sweden, and you will be working outdoors, on the tiled roofs of residential properties.
Your duties will include cleaning tiled roofs and facades. This is a varied job involving many different activities and procedures. Overnight travel may also be required.
At the beginning of your employment, you will receive relevant training in the use of high-pressure cleaning equipment and in working at heights. Previous experience in these areas is, of course, an additional advantage.
The work takes place in different areas of Sweden, from the west coast to the east coast. This means that, alongside your work, you will have the opportunity to experience different parts of the country and discover Sweden from a different perspective.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
This is a physically demanding job that requires good physical ability and skill in using your body, hands, and various tools.
You will work in a two-person team responsible for roof cleaning. For this reason, we place great importance on your ability to cooperate and communicate effectively, accept and handle feedback, and, above all, be willing to work hard and pull your weight when needed.
If you have a colleague or friend who is also interested in coming to work in Sweden, we would be happy to know. The possibility of starting together can make it much easier to form a team, as two people usually work together in each team. In this way, if you come together, the team can be ready from the beginning.
Roof cleaning can involve unexpected challenges related to the surface, dimensions, and similar issues. We are therefore looking for someone who is solution-oriented, is not afraid to take initiative, and can suggest creative solutions.
Naturally, we also want you to be flexible, learn quickly, and contribute to creating a good atmosphere within your team, as well as during any contact with customers.
REQUIREMENTS FOR THE POSITION
• Good knowledge of English.
• B or BE driving licence.
ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Good knowledge of Greek.
• Experience using high-pressure washing equipment, carpentry, roof installation/construction, or similar work involving machinery.
• Experience in the construction and assembly of scaffolding.
• Experience in cleaning and painting tiled roofs, as well as cleaning and painting facades.
WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO WORK AS A ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN AT TAKTEAM?
• A high level of freedom and responsibility in your work.
• Good opportunities for professional development.
• Variety in your daily work, with different types of tasks for our customers.
• Work in different areas of Sweden.
• Accommodation provided for the duration of your employment with us. Team members share the same apartment/accommodation.
• Statutory insurance coverage.
• Good benefits and working conditions.
• Hourly-paid employment.
• Salary is paid on the 25th of each month and covers the work performed during the previous month.
Working in different areas of Sweden is not only a professional opportunity, but also a way to experience the country, visit different places, and gain new experiences.
If you are hardworking, responsible, cooperative, and eager to develop your skills within a growing company, we would be happy to receive your application!

Contact details
If you have any questions about the role or would like to learn more about Epical, please reach out to jessica.keranen@epicalgroup.com.

The Opportunity
Join Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Service team as a Technical Trainer and help shape the next generation of technical expertise. In this role, you will develop and deliver training programs for internal personnel and customers across a wide range of high-voltage technologies, supporting everything from installation and commissioning to maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle services.
Combining technical expertise with a passion for mentoring, you will play a key role in strengthening the capabilities of our organization while helping ensure the safe and reliable operation of critical power infrastructure around the world.
Working from our dedicated training center in Ludvika and occasionally supporting training activities in the field, you will create engaging learning experiences that turn complex technical concepts into practical knowledge, enabling customers and colleagues to perform their work safely, effectively, and with confidence.
How you’ll make an impact
Own and deliver technical training programs across High Voltage products, especially Live Tank Breakers (LTB), supporting customers and internal personnel.
Develop and maintain training curricula, materials, and learning content to ensure training programs reflect the latest products, practices, certification requirements, and industry standards.
Manage competency development and certification activities (especially SF6), including practical assessments, training records, and compliance with applicable training and certification requirements.
Drive the development of the training center and learning offering, identifying capability gaps and introducing new training methods, digital learning solutions, and development initiatives.
Act as a technical subject matter expert and knowledge ambassador, collaborating with product, engineering, and service teams to promote best practices, operational excellence, and a strong safety culture.

Your Background
Experience working with electrical systems, industrial equipment, transformers, motors, generators, or similar technologies in a service, maintenance, commissioning, installation, field engineering, or technical support role.
Ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and practical way, whether through customer interactions, training sessions, workshops, presentations, or knowledge sharing with colleagues.
A self-driven and proactive mindset, with the confidence to work independently and drive improvements and new initiatives.

jobs.occupation: Orthopaedic Specialists Wanted for Coastal Hospital in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Dignus Medical collaborates with several established healthcare providers across Sweden. We are currently receiving ongoing requests from hospitals in central Sweden seeking specialist physicians in orthopaedics. These opportunities arise regularly as healthcare providers expand their orthopaedic services and strengthen their specialist teams.
We are continuously interested in connecting with Orthopaedic Surgeons who are open to exploring professional opportunities in Sweden.
The Role
As a specialist in orthopaedics, you will work in a modern hospital environment alongside multidisciplinary teams focused on high-quality patient care. The clinical work typically includes both elective orthopaedic surgery and acute trauma care, depending on the structure of the department.
Common responsibilities include:
Assessment and treatment of musculoskeletal disorders and injuries
Elective orthopaedic procedures depending on experience and subspecialty
Participation in trauma and emergency orthopaedic care
Outpatient consultations and follow-up care
Collaboration with physiotherapists, radiologists, and other medical specialists
Participation in clinical development and quality improvement work

Hospitals in this region often manage a broad orthopaedic case mix, offering opportunities to work with both common orthopaedic conditions and more complex cases.
Location and Lifestyle
The opportunities are located in a region of central Sweden known for its coastal landscapes, forests, rivers, and open countryside. The area offers excellent access to nature and outdoor activities year-round, including hiking, fishing, skiing, and boating.
Daily life is practical and well-organized. Cities in this region offer short commuting distances, accessible housing, and well-developed public services. Schools, childcare, and healthcare services are easily available, making the region suitable both for individuals relocating alone and for physicians moving with their families.
The lifestyle combines a calm environment with reliable infrastructure and convenient travel connections to larger Swedish cities.
Qualifications
EU-recognized specialist certification in Orthopaedics
Solid clinical experience in orthopaedic practice
Experience in trauma care and elective orthopaedic procedures is beneficial
Ability to work independently while collaborating in multidisciplinary teams
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish

What Dignus Medical Offers You
Ongoing support from a dedicated recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and travel arrangements, including support for your family, if necessary
Access to a free language course with a private tutor

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
Interested in learning more?
Contact us to learn more about current and upcoming opportunities for orthopaedic specialists in Sweden, or submit your application today. Dignus Medical looks forward to helping you explore the next step in your career.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: University Hospital Seeks Pediatric Ophthalmology Specialist
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Join a leading University Hospital in Southwestern Sweden!
Are you a pediatric ophthalmologist from the EU looking to grow your career in a modern, academic, and supportive environment?
A leading university hospital in southwestern Sweden is now recruiting specialists in pediatric ophthalmology to strengthen its highly specialized eye care department. This is an exciting opportunity to work with advanced diagnostics and nationally designated care for pediatric glaucoma and cataract, while contributing to education, clinical development, and research within one of Sweden’s foremost ophthalmology units.
About the role
You will join a large ophthalmology department with more than 250 professionals, covering outpatient care, emergency eye services, inpatient wards, and surgical units. The pediatric ophthalmology section provides comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic care for children and collaborates closely with electrophysiology and hereditary disease units.
You will work in multidisciplinary teams that include physicians, orthoptists, nurses, optometrists, and technicians, all focused on delivering patient-centered, high-quality eye care. As part of a university hospital, you will also have the opportunity to participate in teaching, clinical research, and innovation projects.
Requirements
EU-recognized specialist certification in ophthalmology
Minimum five years of clinical experience in ophthalmology
Focus and competence in pediatric ophthalmology
Strong interest in teaching, research, and clinical development
Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Swedish
Team-oriented, responsible, and committed to providing high-quality patient care
Experience or competence in medical retina is considered an advantage

Language and relocation support
A willingness and motivation to learn Swedish is important for your integration and clinical work.
The relocation process begins once you reach language level B2. During this stage, you will work 50% clinically and study 50% Swedish until you achieve C1 level, which is required to apply for a Swedish specialist license (specialistbevis) to practice as a specialist doctor.
Language training is provided free of charge once you have accepted an employment offer.
You will receive full support throughout the licensing and relocation process, including assistance with documentation, Swedish authorization, and settling in Sweden.

What Dignus Medical offers you
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Why work in southwestern Sweden?
Live and work in one of Sweden’s most beautiful and dynamic regions, combining city life, culture, and nature.
Enjoy a high quality of life with short commutes, clean air, and a safe, family-friendly environment.
You’ll have time for both professional development and personal wellbeing.

Ready to take the next step in your career?
We look forward to supporting your move to Sweden and helping you continue your professional journey as a pediatric ophthalmologist. Contact us for more information, or apply today!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation
Innovation is the heart of Hitachi Energy and our research centers are the backbone.   Join us if you have outstanding scientific or technical expertise as well as drive and passion. Through your research projects you will become part of company-wide community that will shape and help you to develop your career into a technical or managerial leader. Prior knowledge about power systems is welcome, but it is not a requirement.
The opportunity
For our research center in Sweden, we are looking for a research scientist with expertise in the area of Power Electronics, and power system. You will work in dynamic, motivated, and creative teams with a wide range of experience and competence and with access to highly advanced laboratory facilities.
How you'll make an impact
Lead groundbreaking research initiatives that shape the future of sustainable energy, leveraging your advanced expertise in power electronics and power systems.
Develop, design, and implement innovative solutions to technical challenges, driving progress in R&D projects and setting new industry standards.
Utilize state-of-the-art laboratory facilities to conduct experiments, analyze critical data, and validate pioneering concepts for real-world impact.
Take ownership of high-profile R&D projects and work-packages, applying strategic vision, scientific rigor, and exemplary leadership to inspire cross-disciplinary teams.
Develop and champion original ideas, securing funding and support for transformative research that advances energy systems at a global scale.
Engage in dynamic collaborations with leading experts, customers, suppliers, and academic partners, expanding your professional network and influence both within and outside the company.
Deliver high-value outcomes in the form of patent applications, peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, and compelling presentations at international conferences.
Mentor future innovators by sharing your knowledge, fostering creative thinking, and cultivating a culture of excellence and ambition across the organization.

Your background
PhD in Electrical Engineering with specialization in power electronics and/or power systems (or a comparable master’s degree with notable research achievements).
Strong expertise in designing and implementing power electronic converters and controllers, including hands-on experience with hardware prototyping, laboratory validation, and modeling & simulation.

jobs.occupation: Senior Systems Hardware Engineer to global company
jobs.description:
Our client is a global technology company within power transmission and electrification. The organization designs, builds, and upgrades high-voltage transmission installations that move electricity across regions and countries, and its technology is a key enabler of the ongoing energy transition. The site in Ludvika is one of the company's main engineering centres in Sweden, with a large international engineering community and a strong technical tradition.
About HVDC Service The HVDC Service organisation works with upgrades, service and warranty support for HVDC installations already in operation around the world. Since these installations have a lifespan of around many years and are upgraded regularly, this is a long, ongoing pipeline of brownfield engineering work.
About the role We are looking for a Senior Systems Hardware Engineer to join our clients engineering organization supporting HVDC, transmission, grid modernization and substation projects.  In this role you will contribute to hardware engineering, system design, technical evaluations and engineering coordination throughout the project lifecycle. The role offers the opportunity to work on critical energy infrastructure projects supporting the transition towards a more sustainable, reliable and resilient power system.
We are looking for a profile with experience in transmission and distribution systems, substations, hardware engineering, renewable energy integration, battery energy storage systems (BESS), utility environments or other power system applications.
A minimum of 8 years of experience in hardware engineering, system design, transmission and distribution, utility engineering or related energy infrastructure projects is required.
Responsibilities
• Develop and review Plant Circuit Diagrams and related engineering documentation. • Perform hardware selection activities for control, protection and auxiliary systems. • Develop cubicle designs and associated hardware engineering deliverables. • Support engineering teams in HVDC, substation and grid infrastructure projects. • Perform technical studies, system assessments and engineering evaluations. • Coordinate technical activities across multidisciplinary project teams. • Support project execution, planning and stakeholder coordination activities. • Contribute to technical specifications, project documentation and engineering deliverables. • Support customer discussions, technical workshops and engineering reviews. • Participate in risk assessments and technical reviews throughout project execution.
Background
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or equivalent. • Experience with hardware engineering and system design activities for substations, HVDC, FACTS or grid infrastructure projects. • Experience developing Plant Circuit Diagrams and other hardware engineering documentation. • Experience with hardware selection and cubicle design activities. • Experience working with transmission and distribution networks or substations. • Understanding of power system planning, grid integration and energy infrastructure development. • Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering environments. • Fluent English is required. Swedish is considered an advantage.
Meritorious
• Experience from battery energy storage systems (BESS) and energy storage integration projects. • Experience working with regulatory frameworks, permitting processes, grid codes or utility compliance requirements. • Experience from HVDC, FACTS or STATCOM projects. • Experience from renewable energy integration projects. • Experience coordinating engineering activities or technical work packages. • Experience working with utilities, transmission operators or grid owners. • Project Management certification or formal project management experience. • Experience working in international project environments. • Willingness to learn Swedish and engage with the local working environment.

We are expanding our customer engagement and looking for Senior VIL Engineers who will develop, operate, maintain, and continuously improve advanced VIL, Vehicle-in-the-Loop, test environments. The assignment supports multiple vehicle projects and hardware architectures and combines hands-on rig operations, systematic fault tracing, test-environment development, and automation using CAPL and Python.

Responsibilities:
Developing and maintaining VIL test environments according to lifecycle management processes.
Developing automated solutions for VIL environments using Python and CAPL.
Operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting advanced automotive test rigs.
Integrating and maintaining hardware, software, networks, embedded systems, and automation solutions.
Performing systematic fault tracing and root-cause analysis across electrical, mechanical, network, embedded-software, and test-system domains.
Handling support tickets, incident tickets, intake requests, and improvement proposals.
Improving rig stability, monitoring, automation, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Working with different vehicle platforms, architectures, hardware configurations, and mainly the Vector toolchain.
Contributing technical feedback to documentation and electrical schematics.
Collaborating closely with Volvo Cars core teams, stakeholders, Product Owners, and technical leadership.
Taking ownership of assigned project deliveries and reporting status and progress continuously.
Participating in daily stand-ups, sprint activities, technical reviews, and regular team demonstrations
